encoder.objective: B=solve(Z.T W Z + lambda I, Z.T W (Y-mu)), W diagonal weights normalized sum1; fixed lambda=1.0. Equivalent convex weighted centered multivariate ridge leastsquares; targetindicators weakobservations.
encoder.compression: SVD B=U diag(s) V.T; retain first min(8,numericalrank) singularaxes. Encoder E=U_retained diag(s_retained); representation zE. This is SVD compression ofridgecoefficients, not claimed globallyoptimal rankconstrainedridge. Cosine equals corresponding centeredlowrank predictedlabelspace geometry.
encoder.numerical_rank: s_i > max(B.shape)*float64eps*s_0; rank0 if noactive encoderlabels orall singularvalueszero.
encoder.boundary_tie: If numericalrank>8 and abs(s_7-s_8)<=1e-10*s_0, stop thatstage as ambiguous_rank8_boundary; no arbitrarypartial tiedsubspace, fallback or parameterchange. Ties whollyinside retainedsubspace mayrotate; distancesinvariant.
encoder.sign: For each retainedUcolumn, make the largestabsolute-loading element (lowest featureindex iftie) positive; apply sign to correspondingVrow. Persist full singularvalues, active columns/labels, means/scales/targetmeans/B/encoder.

measurement.source_recall10: sum hits amongtop10 / all observed positives, including unmodeled labels and descriptor abstentions.
measurement.mrr: First matching positive reciprocalrank over entire supported labelranking; zero for missing/out-of-support/no-match. Standard mean over labeled queries.
measurement.positive_weighted_mrr: sum(num_source_positives_for_query * reciprocalrank)/sum sourcepositives, explicitly separate from conventional query-averageMRR.
measurement.coverage: nonemptyranking queries/allqueries; also labeled-only coverage. No-targetqueries retained for coverage/counts, excluded fromRecall/MRR denominators.
measurement.component_equal: For each component compute hits/positives, RRsum/labeledqueries and rankingqueries/allqueries; then mean correspondingdefined componentrates. No-targetcomponents excluded only fromRecall/MRR and counted.

Perfold,giantcomponent2 andothercomponents separately. Emptylabelqueries retainedcoverage, excludedlabelmetricdenoms.
measurement.uncertainty: 2000 paired component bootstrap draws with replacement from sorted pooled out-of-fold components, same sampled components acrossarms; PCG64 seed20261016; percentile2.5/97.5 via numpy linearquantile. Reportridge8-minus-raw44 primary; ridge8-minus-balancedGaussian andridge8-minus-popularity secondary; ratio-of-resampledsums forweighted metrics, meanresampled componentrates forcomponent-equal. Conditional on fixed fivefits, NOT refit/bootstrap or confidence in novel corpus. Overlapping fourfold training sets induce dependence acrossOOF predictions; intervals are descriptive fixed-prediction resampling only, not independentfold populationinference or full trainingprocedure uncertainty.

Report candidate/model labelunion ceiling, descriptor-eligible-positive jointceiling, and ranking-available-positive jointceiling separately; all usefullobservedpositive denominator.
